positions.name: OnboardingProcessEstablishment
positions.frame: How is the Pallasine onboarding checklist established as the operative first-week process?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same directional read: src-1 states the checklist's mandatory components as settled practice (present-tense habitual, legitimate authority, decision conviction), and src-2 grounds that settlement in a supersession event — the checklist replaced the old wiki page last quarter. Together they answer how the Pallasine checklist came to be and remains the established onboarding routine, read through the lens of institutional ratification.
